titleEn: A Giant Fish on the Sand

pages.text: Dad's boat floated far out at sea. A wide beach stretched before them.
They wanted to make a big drawing Dad could see from his boat. "Let us draw a really big fish!"
Riri sketched with a stick. Lolo ran to the far side of the beach. "Make a small sketch before a big one." "Just make it big."
Riri drew a fish the size of a footprint, with lots of little scales.
Riri stood and looked at the distant boat. At her feet, the drawing was only palm-sized.
Lolo dragged a stick, drawing huge lines. Even Lolo did not know where the lines were going.
Lolo walked over those very lines. The drawing smudged until nobody could tell what it was.
Riri brought an armful of shells. She placed white dots on the sand, one by one.
The white dots spread into the shape of a fish. Lolo joined dot to dot with a stick.
A huge fish lay on the beach. Toot—the boat horn sounded from the sea. They waved until their arms felt ready to fall off.
